description: Restyle this climber as a different woman: no beanie hat and no scarf. She has long straight vivid red hair (a true red with a slight copper tint) falling past her shoulders, with straight blunt bangs across the forehead, and a small nose ring. She wears a black long-sleeved top and dark charcoal trousers. A small fluffy dark grey cat with bright yellow eyes sits on her shoulder, holding on. Keep the climbing harness, rope, backpack, boots, pose and pixel art style exactly.
